description: This Java source file defines a comprehensive test class 'UserAdministrationTest' for testing user administration functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It includes tests for creating, updating, deleting users, password modifications, permission restrictions, and validation of password policies.

classes.name: UserAdministrationTest
classes.description: Test suite for user administration functionalities including creation, update, deletion, password management, and permission enforcement within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured configuration and request/response specifications before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up transient users created during tests after each test run.

methods.name: testCreateNewUserBlocksDuplicateUsername
methods.description: Verifies system prevents creation of users with duplicate usernames.

methods.name: testUpdateUserAcceptsNewOrSameUsername
methods.description: Checks that updating a user with the same or a new username is accepted.

methods.name: testUpdateUserBlockDuplicateUsername
methods.description: Ensures system blocks updating a user to a username already in use by another user.

methods.name: testCreateNewUserBlocksDuplicateClientId
methods.description: Verifies that creating a user with an already linked self-service client ID is prevented.

methods.name: testDeleteSystemUser
methods.description: Tests restriction on deleting system-critical users.

methods.name: testModifySystemUser
methods.description: Tests restriction on modifying system users.

methods.name: testApplicationUserCanUpdateOwnPassword
methods.description: Checks that users can update their own passwords.

methods.name: testApplicationUserCanChangeOwnPassword
methods.description: Verifies users can change their own passwords.

methods.name: testApplicationUserShallNotBeAbleToChangeItsOwnRoles
methods.description: Ensures users cannot modify their own roles unless permitted.

methods.name: testUserCreationWithValidPassword
methods.description: Validates that user creation succeeds with a password meeting all policies.

methods.name: testUserCreationWithInvalidPasswords
methods.description: Ensures user creation fails with passwords that violate policy rules, validating password strength enforcement.
